about.أهلًا بيك في ENGLISH SAVANT، مساحة تعليم: Welcome to ENGLISH SAVANT, a learning space that aims to bring English closer to you, make it easier to understand, and more enjoyable to use.
about.أنا مستر باسم حريز (Mr. Basem Hreaz)، مد: I'm Basem Hreaz (Mr. Basem Hreaz), an English teacher. I believe that learning a language is more than memorizing words and grammar or answering exam questions. It is a journey that starts with understanding the basics and leads to being able to use the language independently, think in it, and express your ideas with confidence.
about.بدأت ENGLISH SAVANT بفكرة إن كل طالب يست: I started ENGLISH SAVANT with the idea that every student deserves a different learning experience: one that takes their level into account, understands their needs, and helps them improve step by step, rather than simply receive information.
about.إننا نقدم تجربة تعليمية تساعد كل متعلم ي: To offer a learning experience that helps every learner discover their abilities, improve their English, and use it in their studies, daily life, and future.
about.مش هدفنا إنك تعرف الإجابة الصحيحة بس، هد: Our aim is for you to understand why an answer is correct and be able to work it out yourself next time, rather than only know the correct answer.
about.أنا مؤمن إن التعليم الحقيقي بيبدأ لما ال: I believe real learning starts when a student understands, rather than memorizes.
about.عشان كده، بنهتم إن كل درس يكون مبني على: That is why we focus on building each lesson around understanding and practice, helping students connect ideas and use what they learn in real situations.
about.بنحاول نخلي رحلة التعلم:: We try to make the learning journey:
about.بسيطة: نشرح المعلومة بطريقة واضحة تناسب: Simple: we explain ideas clearly in a way that suits the student's level.
about.متدرجة: نبدأ من الأساس، ونبني عليه خطوة: Gradual: we start with the basics and build on them step by step.
about.تفاعلية: الطالب يشارك، ويفكر، ويجرب، مش: Interactive: students take part, think, and try things, rather than only listen.
Practical: we connect language with everyday situations.
about.مستمرة: كل خطوة صغيرة هي جزء من تطور أكب: Ongoing: every small step is part of greater progress.
about.في ENGLISH SAVANT، بنهتم بتقديم محتوى تع: At ENGLISH SAVANT, we focus on providing learning content for different stages and levels:
about.رحلة تبدأ من الحروف والأصوات، وتساعد الم: A journey that starts with letters and sounds and helps learners build a strong foundation in reading, vocabulary, and sentence formation.
about.شرح ومراجعة وتدريب على اللغة الإنجليزية: English explanations, revision, and practice for different school stages, with attention to vocabulary, grammar, reading, exercises, and exam preparation.
about.محتوى وأدوات تساعدك تتعلم بنفسك، وتحدد م: Content and tools to help you learn independently, assess your level, choose your goals, and track your progress in English.
about.مسار للمتعلمين اللي عايزين يبدأوا من الص: A path for learners who want to start from scratch, improve their level, or learn English for study, work, and communication.
about.اختبارات، تدريبات تفاعلية، مساعد تعليمي،: Tests, interactive exercises, a learning assistant, and a range of resources to help you practice English more flexibly.
about.مش كل الطلاب بيتعلموا بنفس الطريقة، ومش: Students do not all learn in the same way, and information does not always get across through the same approach.
about.عشان كده، بنحاول نوفر طرق مختلفة للتعلم،: That is why we try to offer different ways to learn, combining explanations, examples, practice, and application, so you can return to information whenever you need it and learn at your own pace.
about.هدفنا إنك تنتقل من:: Our aim is to help you move from:
about.لأننا بنؤمن إن كل شخص عنده القدرة على تع: Because we believe everyone has the ability to learn a language, whatever their current level.
about.مش مهم بدأت منين، المهم إنك تبدأ، وتستمر: Where you start is not what matters. What matters is starting, continuing, and giving yourself a chance to improve.
about.هنا، الغلط مش نهاية التعلم، لكنه جزء منه: Here, mistakes are part of learning, not its end. Every new word, every grammar point you understand, and every sentence you manage to say independently is a step closer to your goal.
about.متستناش لما تكون ممتاز في الإنجليزي عشان: Do not wait until your English is excellent before you start using it.
about.ابدأ بمستواك الحالي، واتعلم، وجرب، واغلط: Start at your current level. Learn, try, make mistakes, correct them, and keep going.

privacy.اعرف إيه اللي بيتحفظ على جهازك وإيه اللي: See what stays on your device and what is sent to services.
privacy.مش محتاج تعمل حساب أو تدخل كلمة سر. اسم: You do not need an account or password. Search names and your phone number are not collected. Your teacher adds public results after obtaining appropriate permission. There is no booking form that sends data to a server, and no added advertising or analytics tools.
privacy.المتصفح بيحفظ اختيارك لشكل الموقع ونتائج: The browser saves your site appearance choice and exercise results. Some Final Review pages save your written answers and choices on the same device so you can return to them. This data may remain after you close the page. If the device is shared, clear the site data from your browser settings when you finish. Clearing the results history alone does not necessarily clear saved review answers.
privacy.لا تكتب أي أسماء أو بيانات شخصية، وخاصة: Do not enter names or personal data, especially children's data. An automated check rejects some obvious personal data before sending and before passing text to the model, but it cannot guarantee detection of every name or identifying detail. Use general study text only. Younger learners should use the tools with a parent or guardian, without an account or sign-in portal.
privacy.عند طلب شرح أو ترجمة أو أسئلة، تُرسل اخت: When you request an explanation, translation or questions, your school-year and topic choices, plus any question or study text you enter, are sent to Cloudflare Workers AI. The text tools use its Qwen, Llama and Mistral models, depending on the request. Some basic rules have clearly marked, reviewed fixed explanations instead of generated ones. For photo questions, the selected image and accompanying text are sent to a vision model at the service. Do not upload pictures of people or pages containing names, grades or personal data. In optional adult practice, after consent within the page, the level, goal, chosen field and latest part of the conversation are sent to keep the practice in context. The conversation stays in page memory while the page is open; the site does not create a permanent conversation record. There is no student account or user database, and we do not store request or response content on the site's server. Ready-made practice answers are marked in the browser and are not sent for marking. The service is not endorsed by the Ministry of Education. Answers and explanations may be wrong or may link a question to the curriculum incorrectly.
privacy.تُحمّل الخطوط من Google Fonts. عند الضغط: Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts. When you press Listen to the explanation, the explanation text and the question ID or a short part of its context are sent to the voice service to prepare the Achird voice. The device voice may be used as a fallback when the service is unavailable. The site may also load ready-made audio and video files. WhatsApp and Instagram links open external services. GitHub, Cloudflare and Google may process technical data such as IP addresses and security data to provide their services. Cloudflare says it does not use Workers AI content to train models, and normal request processing does not keep inputs and outputs after delivering the response, subject to the legal exceptions and operational data in its policy. Not having a database does not mean hosting providers process no technical data.
privacy.لوحة الشرف والنتائج متاحة لأي حد، وملف ا: The honor board and results are available to anyone, and the full data file can be read. Name and grade search runs inside your browser; this is not a private grades portal. Your teacher adds names, grades and photos after obtaining appropriate permission. Do not add phone numbers, identity documents or private data. The teacher supplied the existing results for inclusion on the site.
privacy.لو عندك سؤال، كلّم MR. BASEM HREAZ على و: For questions, contact MR. BASEM HREAZ on WhatsApp.
privacy.الخدمة على الخطة المجانية فقط، وقد تتوقف: The service uses the free plan only. Requests may stop when the shared daily limit is reached or demand is high. Visitors do not pay. Workers AI data policy · Qwen model usage rules.

article-common-english-mistakes.أشهر أخطاء المصريين في الإنجليزي: Common English mistakes made by Egyptian learners
article-common-english-mistakes.غلطات صغيرة متكررة بتفرق بين إنجليزي مكس: Small repeated mistakes make the difference between broken English and correct English. We collected the most common mistakes Egyptians make in grammar, vocabulary and pronunciation, with the correction and the reason for each one.
article-common-english-mistakes.من أشهر الغلطات: I am agree. الصح: I agr: One of the most common mistakes: "I am agree." The correct form: "I agree." The word agree is a verb, not an adjective, so do not put am before it. The same idea applies to "I am not agree"; the correct form is "I don't agree."
article-common-english-mistakes.نسيان حرف الـ s مع he و she: Forgetting the s with he and she
article-common-english-mistakes.كتير بيقولوا He go to school. الصح: He g: Many people say "He go to school." The correct form: "He goes to school." With he, she and it in the present simple, the verb takes an s. A small rule, but it makes a big difference in the impression.
article-common-english-mistakes.ترجمة حرفية من \"عندي 20 سنة\". الإنجليز: A word-for-word translation of "عندي 20 سنة" (I have 20 years). English has no have with age. The correct form: "I am 20 years old." In Arabic we own the years; in English we are our age.
article-common-english-mistakes.بنقول بالعربي \"افتح النور\"، فبنقولها o: We say "افتح النور" (open the light) in Arabic, so we say "open the light." The correct form: "turn on the light." Devices, lights and air conditioners are opened with turn on and closed with turn off.
article-common-english-mistakes.لما تقصد الليلة اللي فاتت، التعبير المعت: When you mean the night that passed, the usual expression is last night. The word yesterday can come with morning, afternoon and evening, not only with the early parts of the day.
article-common-english-mistakes.كلمة people في الإنجليزي جمع دايمًا. فمت: The word people in English is always plural. So do not say "the people is"; the correct form is "the people are." Just as we say in Arabic "الناس بيكلموا" (people talk), not "بيكلم" (talks).
article-common-english-mistakes.الحرف p مش موجود في العربي، فكتير بينطقو: The letter p does not exist in Arabic, so many people pronounce it as b: Pepsi comes out "بيبسي" (Bebsi) and park comes out "بارك" (bark). The exercise is simple: put your hand in front of your mouth; the letter p comes out with a clear puff of air, b does not.
article-common-english-mistakes.حروف th بتتحول لـ s أو z: three تتقال \": The letters th turn into s or z: three is said "سري" (sree) and the is said with a heavy sound. The correct way is for the tip of the tongue to come out between the teeth. three is not sree, and this is not zis. A simple exercise makes a real difference in how people understand you.
article-common-english-mistakes.بنقول \"نعمل حفلة\"، لكن التعبير الإنجلي: We say "نعمل حفلة" (make a party), but the usual English expressions are have a party or throw a party. With breakfast, have breakfast means you eat it, and make breakfast means you prepare it. Both are correct, but the meaning is different.
article-common-english-mistakes.إزاي تتخلص من الغلطات دي؟: How do you get rid of these mistakes?
article-common-english-mistakes.الحل مش حفظ قواعد أكتر، الحل إنك تتعلم ا: The solution is not memorizing more rules; it is learning the correct expression as one piece from a reliable source: hear the correct sentence, repeat it out loud, and use it. A mistake learned over years is fixed by correct repetition, and a teacher who catches your mistakes as they happen shortens the road.

article-english-for-career.الإنجليزي النهاردة مش رفاهية ولا مادة در: English today is not a luxury or just a school subject; it is a real work tool. In this article we see why, and how its effect shows up in your salary and opportunities.
article-english-for-career.الإنجليزي مش مهارة زيادة، دي لغة الشغل: English is not an extra skill; it is the language of work
article-english-for-career.في أغلب الشغلانات الكويسة النهاردة، الإن: In most good jobs today, English is not a formality on the CV. It decides whether you understand the training, answer emails, and pass the interview at all. Large and multinational companies work in English even when their offices are in Egypt.
article-english-for-career.اللي بيتكلم إنجليزي كويس بيترشح لشغلانات: People who speak English well get shortlisted for better-paying jobs, because they can work with clients and teams outside Egypt. Remote work has also opened the door to working with foreign companies from home, but its first condition is strong English.
article-english-for-career.الإنجليزي في الإنترفيو بيفرق فعلاً: English really makes a difference in the interview
article-english-for-career.كتير من المقابلات الشخصية فيها جزء بالإن: Many interviews include an English part even when the job does not need it daily. Why? Because it measures your confidence and the way you think. One correct, confident sentence is very different from a hesitant word-for-word translation.
article-english-for-career.البرمجة والتكنولوجيا، السياحة والطيران،: Programming and technology, tourism and aviation, nursing and pharmacy, marketing and sales, even engineering. In each of these fields, those who read and understand English grow faster because they learn directly from the source.
article-english-for-career.مش لازم تكون بادئ من الصفر لوحدك. ابدأ ب: You do not have to start from zero on your own. Start by setting your goal: an interview? Working with clients? Reading in your field? Then build on that goal. A small step every day is better than a big plan that never happens.

article-english-for-study.من المدرسة للجامعة للبحث العلمي، الإنجلي: From school to university to academic research, English is the key to original knowledge. This article answers one question: why does a student who is strong in English have a real advantage?
article-english-for-study.أغلب المعرفة مكتوبة بالإنجليزي: Most knowledge is written in English
article-english-for-study.الأبحاث العلمية، الكتب المرجعية، والكورس: Scientific research, reference books, and global courses are mostly in English. Those who read English reach the information at its source, not through a late, translated summary.
article-english-for-study.في كليات كتير زي الطب والهندسة والعلوم،: In many faculties such as medicine, engineering and science, the main references are in English. And if you are planning a master's degree, a scholarship, or studying abroad, tests like IELTS and TOEFL are a basic gateway.
article-english-for-study.يوتيوب، المنصات التعليمية، الوثائقيات، و: YouTube, learning platforms, documentaries, and podcasts. The largest learning library in history is available for free, but its key is English. Learning a little English opens up a whole world.
article-english-for-study.الإنجليزي بيقوي التفكير مش بس اللغة: English strengthens thinking, not just language
article-english-for-study.تعلّم لغة تانية بيديك فرص تتدرّب على الف: Learning a second language trains you to understand, express yourself, and deal with different sources. The benefit differs from one student to another, and mastering English alone is no guarantee of a better memory or top marks in every subject.
article-english-for-study.الإنجليزي مش مادة تتذاكر قبل الامتحان وب: English is not a subject to study only before the exam; it is a skill built step by step. Fifteen minutes of reading or listening every day makes a bigger difference over the year than two nights of heavy cramming.

article-self-study-english.إزاي تذاكر إنجليزي لوحدك من غير كورسات؟: How can you study English on your own without courses?
article-self-study-english.مش لازم كورس غالي عشان تتعلم إنجليزي. كل: You do not need an expensive course to learn English. All the tools exist for free; what is missing is a clear plan and daily commitment. Here is a practical plan you can start today.
article-self-study-english.الهدف أولًا: بتتعلم ليه؟: The goal first: why are you learning?
article-self-study-english.قبل ما تفتح أي مصدر، حدد هدفك: عايز تتكل: Before opening any resource, set your goal: do you want to speak at work? Succeed at school or university? Travel? The goal decides what you study. Someone learning without a goal gets lost and quits after two weeks.
article-self-study-english.خطة يومية صغيرة مش بطولية: A small daily plan, not a heroic one
article-self-study-english.15-20 دقيقة كل يوم أحسن من 3 ساعات يوم و: 15-20 minutes every day is better than 3 hours on one day a week. Split it: 5 minutes of new words, 5 of listening, 5 of reading aloud, 5 of writing your own sentences. A full month of consistency matters more than two days of excitement.
article-self-study-english.احفظ الكلمات في جمل مش لوحدها: Memorize words in sentences, not on their own
article-self-study-english.كلمة لوحدها بتتنسى، كلمة جوه جملة بتتثبت: A word on its own gets forgotten; a word inside a sentence sticks. Don't say "I'll memorize every"; say "I drink coffee every morning." Write the sentence by hand or in a note on your phone, and review it after two days and after a week.
article-self-study-english.ودنك قبل عينك: الاستماع اليومي: Your ear before your eye: daily listening
article-self-study-english.خصص وقت يومي للاستماع: فيديوهات قصيرة لل: Set aside daily listening time: short videos for beginners, songs with their lyrics, or audio stories. At first you will understand only words, and that is normal. Your ear gets used to the rhythm before you understand the meaning.
article-self-study-english.مش شرط حد يسمعك. صف يومك بإنجليزي وانت ب: Nobody has to hear you. Describe your day in English as you do it: "I am making tea now." Repeat sentences you heard with the same intonation. This trains your pronunciation muscles and removes the fear of speaking.
article-self-study-english.مصادر مجانية تبدأ بيها فورًا: Free resources to start with right away
article-self-study-english.يوتيوب فيه قنوات كاملة لتعليم الإنجليزي: YouTube has whole channels teaching English to Arabic speakers from zero, leveled reading stories, and dictionary apps with audio pronunciation for any word. Pick one source for each skill and stick to it; constantly jumping between sources wastes time.
article-self-study-english.آخر كل أسبوع راجع: الكلمات اللي فضلت ثاب: At the end of each week, review: which words stayed with you? Which sentences can you now say easily? Whatever has not stuck goes back into next week's plan. Self-assessment is what turns studying into real progress.
